exposure: cutaneous rash in child at 2 months
outcome: wheezing phenotypes (no symptoms, intermittent, persistent, incident)
cohort: The study included 18,041 infants from the ELFE (French Longitudinal Study of Children) birth cohort.
finding: Respiratory symptoms (cough, respiratory distress, and excessive bronchial secretion) and maternal smoking during pregnancy were significantly associated with a high risk of persistent and incident wheezing at one year.
